prompt: Create a dark architecture diagram for a client calling an access gateway and then a core service backed by a data store. The gateway and core service share the same runtime platform.
expected_behavior: Shows the client-to-gateway-to-service-to-store path as the primary flow
Shows the shared runtime as a labeled dashed dependency domain rather than per-node dependency arrows
Uses aligned grid placement, consistent component sizing, and a legend outside architecture boundaries
Uses facing anchors with perpendicular final entry segments and keeps all component text inside its box
Renders the HTML and checks connector endpoints and text overlap before delivery

prompt: Create an architecture diagram with two parallel request paths, a policy service that sends control rules, an audit service that receives security events, and a shared platform used by three services. Keep the layout compact and readable.
expected_behavior: Keeps auxiliary control and audit nodes out of the primary request chains
Uses distinct solid, dashed, and security-colored dashed connections
Routes connectors to component edges or explicit anchors without overlapping labels
Uses one shared dependency domain without redundant dependency arrows
